lesson.summary: Scope a check-coverage defect to the full advertised guarantee, not the one instance you noticed
lesson.synthesized_rule: When a review or spike finds that a check does not cover something its own description advertises, measure the FULL advertised-vs-delivered gap before scoping the fix. Report the ratio (N covered of M advertised), then deliberately choose scope. Fixing only the instance you happened to notice leaves the false guarantee standing and hides the class.
